rationale: Builds on the current 9x512 recurrent-tail baseline without changing export or eval. The new change only alters late-phase training: once quant-aware mode activates, the training loss upweights the last tokens in each sequence, matching the official sliding-stride scorer where most evaluated targets come from tail positions. This is a compact validation-aligned objective shift, not another small LR sweep, and it stays compile-stable and byte-neutral.
title: Late Quant-Aware Tail-Aligned Loss
